title: Cilantro Lime Mexican Jicama Salad
description: A fresh and crunchy salad made with jicama, cilantro, and lime, perfect for a light vegetarian meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine diced jicama and chopped cilantro.
In a small bowl, whisk together lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Pour the lime dressing over the jicama mixture and toss to coat.
Add crushed tortilla chips and chopped pepper to the bowl and toss again.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, garnish with a slice of flan and serve chilled.
